_comment: Hand-editable. `median` is the resale value the scorer compares against. `liquidity` is a manual 1-5 tier (5 = very commonly traded / easy to flip, 1 = niche). Prices are rough USD estimates for the SECONDARY market — correct these with real comps. `aliases` are lowercase substrings matched against listing titles. FILTERS: `excludeTitleTerms` reject a listing outright when its title contains one (junk/parts/condition words). `noveltyTerms` reject non-watch novelty items (USB figures, keychains, posters, replicas, etc.) even when a brand/model name matches. NOTE: bare 'manual'/'display'/'pin'/'coin' were intentionally NOT included — they collide with legit watch terms (manual wind, display caseback, pin buckle, coin-edge bezel); specific phrases like 'instruction manual'/'lapel pin'/'challenge coin' are used instead. `matchExcludeTerms` disqualify a brand match even if the alias appears (homage/tribute listings). `vintageTerms` mark a listing as vintage so it isn't scored against the modern median (the scorer also treats any 19xx year/decade in the title as vintage). All matched as whole words, case-insensitive. `accessoryTerms` + `watchIndicativeTerms`: drop a listing whose title has an accessory word (belt/band/strap) UNLESS it also has a watch-indicative term (automatic/quartz/…/a size like 40mm) — catches straps/belts a seller miscategorized under Wristwatches, without dropping real watches that mention a bracelet/band. `allowedLeafCategoryIds` keeps only eBay items whose leaf category is a real wristwatch category (excludes straps/belts/parts by CATEGORY, not title). `staleDaysByLiquidity` maps a model's liquidity tier (1-5) to the days-listed threshold at which a still-present listing is flagged stale (high-liquidity brands get longer since they normally move fast). `profit`: estimatedNetProfit = median*resaleFactor*(1-ebayFeePct) - shippingEstimate - price; listings under `minNetProfit` are filtered out (this is IN ADDITION to the discount-% threshold).
